```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go

def err_bar(x, y, color):
    f = go.Figure(go.Bar(x=x, y=y, marker_color=color, text=[f"{v:+.2f}°" for v in y], textposition="outside"))
    f.update_layout(height=300, margin=dict(t=10, b=10), xaxis_title="Desired angle (°)",
                    yaxis_title="Error (°)", template="plotly_white", xaxis=dict(type="category"))
    return f
```

## MCP functional test (open loop)

| Desired (°) | Error (°) | Error (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 4.40 | -14.67 |
| 50 | 5.57 | -11.14 |
| 70 | 6.47 | -9.24 |

```{python}
err_bar([30, 50, 70], [4.4, 5.57, 6.47], "#14b8a6").show()
```

Max 70° demand → 63.53° actual; below the safety limit of 89.91°. Smooth 0-70° transient.

## PIP functional test (open loop)

| Desired (°) | Error (°) | Error (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 50 | -8.25 | 16.50 |
| 70 | -27.15 | 38.79 |

```{python}
err_bar([50, 70], [-8.25, -27.15], "#f97316").show()
```

Max 90° demand → 106° actual; below the safety limit of 114.10°. The larger PIP error is an honest limitation of open loop.

## Outcome

::: {.callout-tip}
The prototype actuated the index finger in passive-assist mode within the safe ROM (110° PIP, 90° MCP), achieved cylindrical grasp, and was unable to achieve tip pinch.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**Limitations:** only the index finger was actuated; open-loop accuracy is limited by backlash. **Future work:** low-module/backlash-free sensing, then reinstate closed-loop control.
:::
